headline: Aselsan Secures $1.1 Billion Overseas Air Defense Export Contract
summary: Turkish defense company Aselsan signed a $1.1 billion contract to supply air defense systems to an overseas customer.
why: Large defense export contracts provide multi-year revenue visibility and underpin growth for major aerospace and defense manufacturers.
